posts.text:
I think the administration definitely has a leak problem. But its defenders often want to have it both ways, insisting the leaks must stop AND the leaks are not true. 

If they’re lies they’re lies, not leaks. 

If they’re leaks, they have to have at least some truth to them.
posts.summary: Criticizes administration's contradictory leak denials as logically incoherent
